set.body:
The real ds000001 MNI workflow now fits every original run at all206086 common voxels. Native projections retain5 shared coefficients for beta and17 for FIR (including the shared intercept). FixedEffects.contribution materializes scale(basePrecision,1/variance) as a separate dense q-by-q DMat for every voxel in every run. FixedEffectsSufficientStatistics retains those run contributions; materialize also retains each combined voxel covariance and builds voxelwise total precision. With4 participants and3 runs, run precisions plus combined covariance alone require4*(3+1)*206086*17*17*8 =7623533312 bytes (7.10GiB) for FIR, excluding object overhead, totalPrecision builders, beta/SE matrices, original run fits, group matrices and views. This is a source-derived numeric payload lower bound, not an observed OOM. Beta analogous lower bound is659475200 bytes. PLS Neuro currently retains ParticipantResponses with their native sufficient statistics.

Owner: ScalaFIM fit shared module. Introduce a general compact representation for structured voxelwise precision/covariance (e.g. shared base matrices with voxelwise scales, and suitable summed-precision/solve representation), preserving exact joint inverse-covariance estimation, full estimand axis, row/run/voxel identity, covariance/SE access and auditable sufficient statistics. Do not drop the intercept, take diagonal weighting, change estimands, discard uncertainty or downsample the real data to avoid the storage problem. Keep support for genuinely unstructured covariance and make intentional materialization explicit and bounded.

Acceptance: public FixedEffects API reproduction and same-result independent small heteroscedastic/correlated run examples; meaningful realistic storage/read/working-memory instrumentation; associativity and all-run/availability behavior preserved; malformed structures rejected; JVM and Scala.js tests; consumer full MNI FIR cohort fits under an explicitly measured budget. Check the optional resolvedVoxelStatuses fallback separately for repeated full-vector allocation; real chunked run results currently carry explicit statuses, so that fallback is not the observed cause here.

Real first-level evidence: PLS Neuro RealFirstLevelFit, /private/tmp/plsneuro-real-first-level-fit-1; all8 full-grid unit/model fits succeeded at512-voxel reads and3GiB heap. Independent NumPy sampled OLS oracle agrees at3 absolute voxels across24 run/model fits (maximum beta error7.54e-10, SE2.77e-10). Consumer resource issue bd-01M1SAV0AF4P4X8BQRRE8MJBA0; durable evidence being retained in plsneuro/docs/verification/real-first-level-fit-evidence.json. This issue is open implementation work, not a completed repair.
set.title: Represent structured voxelwise fixed-effects precision and covariance compactly
